route_summary: Python awswrangler Athena query helper that executes a caller-provided SELECT/WITH query and returns the actual pandas DataFrame using explicit database, result bucket, and workgroup.
supported_boundary: Python 3.11+, awswrangler 3.17.1, pandas 2.2.3, boto3 1.43.114, valid AWS credentials, Athena workgroup, Glue catalog database, and S3 query-results location. Invocation can run billable remote queries; hosted preview does not execute them.
